gloss: to eat; to drink; to wear (honorific)

definitions.explanation: An honorific verb used to describe someone of high status eating or drinking. More elevated than {食|た}べる or {飲|の}む.
An honorific verb for wearing clothes or accessories. Often heard in retail settings as お{召|め}しになる.
An honorific verb meaning to summon or call someone. Used in formal or historical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧⟦お{召|め}し{上|あ}がり→お召し上がり：26515_omeshiagari⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がります→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What would you like to eat, sir/madam?

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がりました→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Has the president already had lunch?

examples.japanese: {素敵|すてき}な⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{召|め}しです⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: What a lovely dress you're wearing.

examples.japanese: ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{召|め}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりません→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like to try on this coat?

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{召|め}しになって⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: It's cold, so please put on a jacket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧お⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{召|め}した。

⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{臣下|しんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{御前|ごぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{召|め}して⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられている→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the emperor summoned his subjects before him to seek their opinions.

notes:
USAGE: {召|め}す is an honorific (sonkeigo) verb with several meanings depending on context. The most common modern uses are お⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がる→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧ (to eat/drink, honorific) and お{召|め}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to wear, honorific).

The "summon" meaning is mostly used in historical or formal contexts.

ASPECT (て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧): お{召|め}しになっている describes the state of wearing something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がる→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧: to eat/drink (honorific compound)
- お{召|め}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to wear (honorific form)
- お{召|め}し{物|もの}: clothing (honorific)
- [food/drink]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{召|め}し{上|あ}がる→召し上がる：01310_meshiagaru⟧ (to eat/drink something)
- [clothing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{召|め}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to wear something)
- [person]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{召|め}す (to summon someone)
